items.question: What is the Loomis Method?
items.answer: The Loomis Method is a portrait drawing framework that starts with a simplified head shape, then adds center lines, facial landmarks, and proportions so the face can be drawn with structure instead of guesswork.

items.question: What can I learn to draw with Sketch Steps?
items.answer: Portraits and faces with the Loomis method, pets and other animals with the Animal Drawing style, and line drawings from Tracing Studio in categories such as animals, anime and cars.

items.question: Is Sketch Steps suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Sketch Steps is designed for beginners and aspiring artists who want clear, repeatable drawing steps without having to search through random tutorials.

items.question: Can I use my own photos?
items.answer: Yes. You can generate guides from face photos in your gallery or from a new camera capture, making every practice session personal.

items.question: What is Trace AI?
items.answer: Trace AI turns a photo into an image in one of six effects: Clean Pencil, Bold Charcoal, Anime Ink, Architectural Line, Soft Sketch or Watercolor. You can save the result to Photos or use it for tracing.

items.question: Does the app support tracing?
items.answer: Yes. The tracing studio lets you practice directly over guided references while you learn the construction behind each portrait.

items.question: Is the app free?
items.answer: Sketch Steps can be downloaded from the App Store or Google Play and includes free tutorials. Pricing and premium options are shown in the app before any purchase.

items.question: Is there an Android version?
items.answer: Yes. Sketch Steps is available now on Google Play.
